0022600140.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (0-2, 10th in the West, on a two-game losing streak) host the Denver Nuggets (0-1, 11th in the West) in the Pelicans' fourth game of the season. Yves Missi is out for New Orleans with a knee bruise, and Julian Strawther is out for Denver with a knee sprain. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Pelicans lost all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently 122-116 in New Orleans on January 13, 2026.
